# Compact profiles

Synthetic-only prototype. Nothing here is a clinical-deployment, SMART-authorization, vendor-support or protocol-compatibility claim.

Schema `compact-profiles/1`, workflow `recent-labs-v1`, source release `hl7.fhir.r4.core@4.0.1`.

## Recipe `r4-lab-evidence-v1/Observation.2`

Applies to `Observation` only. Kept roots stay whole (codings, Quantity comparators and systems, components and ranges are never pruned or normalized): `status`, `category`, `code`, `subject`, `focus`, `effective[x]`, `issued`, `value[x]`, `dataAbsentReason`, `interpretation`, `bodySite`, `method`, `specimen`, `device`, `referenceRange`, `hasMember`, `derivedFrom`, `component`.

Always kept: resourceType; id; every root isModifier element; contained when a kept element references it (#id). Identity supplement (also re-added to field-selected views): of `meta`, only versionId, profile, security, SUBSETTED tags, primitive companions of the above.

Omission policy: Actually-present omitted roots and dropped meta paths are disclosed per record; the recipe ID never substitutes for actual omission paths. Unknown modifier/implicitRules/policy-withheld modifier forces the structural sanitized view instead of a clinical compact interpretation.

## Efficiency status

- Claim: **none**. Measured default: `fhir`.
- Stratum: unfulfilled: no natural pinned Synthea heldout corpus exists in this worktree, so efficiency attainment is unmeasured and no smaller-at-equal-fidelity claim is made.
- Within-product target: median paired model-visible Tcompact/Tfhir ≤0.90 (Addendum C.1); attainment unmeasured until the frozen heldout run.
- C.1 compact fidelity: median paired total model-visible result tokens Tcompact/Tfhir ≤0.90 with full fidelity (Addendum C.1: 100% critical fact/citation/meaning checks, no deterministic task-success loss, and every applicable required fidelity mutant killed); the separate evidence-of-smaller requirement is a 95% interval upper endpoint <1.0; attainment unmeasured until the frozen heldout run.
- C.2 delivery efficiency: absolute model-visible bytes and tokens per correctly answered lab question, with median/p90 and every attempted outcome; same-format full-text versus verified-slim paired absolute savings are reported separately from within-profile compact/fhir ratios (Addendum C.2); no numerical delivery-reduction threshold is adopted and full-text remains the delivery default.
- C.3 envelope overhead: median per-task combined provenance + withheld-entry + coverage bytes ≤15% of structuredContent bytes, measured separately for the fhir and compact arms (Addendum C.3); task-level attainment unmeasured.
- Default rule: Default stays fhir until C.1 is met on measured data (Addendum C.4). In addition to section 4 eligibility and release-wide cell-coverage rules, every advertised measured cell used to justify a workflow/type compact default must meet the ≤0.90 point target, be statistically smaller (95% interval upper endpoint <1.0), and pass fidelity, task-success, and mutation gates. Not-smaller, indeterminate, unmeasured, or target-unmet cells retain fhir; preserve structural-projection labels and explicit requested/actual format and fallback disclosures. An unmet C.3 target is reported separately; delivery savings cannot stand in for C.1. The lab recipe is an explicit-format clinical projection; no efficiency claim. The 0.1 gateway runtime default is unchanged by P and any default flip is root integration work.
- Lab recipe at envelope level: Wired into gateway projection for eligible compact Observations without explicit field selection; qualifying heldout token efficiency remains unmeasured and C.1 attainment is not established..
- Token status: Lab heldout token efficiency remains unmeasured. Hash-locked tiktoken 0.12.0 and cl100k_base/o200k_base encoding pins exist in scripts/requirements-tokenizers.txt and packages/evals/data/tokenizers.lock.json. docs/S5-STATUS.md publishes exploratory catalog token figures and records the pinned container run as unexecuted; those figures do not establish lab heldout efficiency or token acceptance.
